def first(records, width):
    matching = [r for r in records if r > 0]
    if not matching:
        return "none"
    lines = []
    for r in matching:
        lines.append(f"{r:{width:02}}")
        lines.append(f"[{r}]")
        lines.append(f"<{r}>")
    lines.sort()
    lines.reverse()
    total = len(lines)
    lines.append(str(total))
    return "\n".join(lines)


def second(records, width):
    matching = [r for r in records if r > 0]
    if not matching:
        return "none"
    lines = []
    for r in matching:
        lines.append(f"{r:{width:03}}")
        lines.append(f"[{r}]")
        lines.append(f"<{r}>")
    lines.sort()
    lines.reverse()
    total = len(lines)
    lines.append(str(total))
    return "\n".join(lines)
